integrity: The cardinality, exhaustive equality census, complete no-five-code search, symmetry orbits, stabilizers, representatives, and structural profiles are regenerated by a standalone Python verifier using the literal traceability definition.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only \(2\)-traceability codes of length three over a four-symbol alphabet. It does not classify optimal codes for other alphabets or lengths; a residual historical-priority risk remains for an obscure unindexed enumeration.
title: Seven Hamming-isometry classes of optimal \(q=4\) length-three \(2\)-traceability codes
